rationale: The analysis captures all required findings: a segment-specific model failure, limited initial exposure, segment monitoring plus an automated halt threshold, and targeted feature-flag rollback. It correctly avoids claiming that passing integration tests guaranteed correctness or that the deployment was failure-free. Most causal claims are well bounded and confidence-calibrated, though a few relationships and counterfactuals are more inferential than the evidence directly establishes, particularly treating the test gap as contributing to the defect rather than to production exposure. Actions preserve the demonstrated protective controls while addressing the unexplained segment defect and testing gap.
